text:
Maria: Quick reminder — aiming to cut release v0.8.3 at 17:00 UTC today. Need final reviews/approvals and backports merged. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4123 (runtime: routing fallback), https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4132 (changelog + docs), https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4118 (dedicated: backports). Please ping if you have blockers.

Alex: Looking now, will review PR 4123 in ~30m.

Jia: 4132 is just docs + changelog, small nits left. @Sam can you approve the changelog wording? I used 'fixed' vs 'improved' for the runtime note.

Sam: On it. Quick question: do we need a backport for 4105 (kv-cache) into 0.8.x? That one touches kernel-paths and could be risky.

Leo: 4105 is low risk but touches kernels. I'd prefer a dedicated backport PR rather than cherry-picking into the release branch. @Alex can you open one?

Alex: Opened backport PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4140 — includes tests and a short description. CI queued.

Alex: For reference, cherry-pick I used for the branch: 
```
git checkout release/0.8.x
git cherry-pick -x 3f2b1a4
git push origin release/0.8.x
```

Maria: Thanks. For the changelog, please follow the format: 'component: short description (PR #)'. Ping me once 4132 is green.

deploy-bot: CI job for PR #4123 queued — see https://ci.internal/redwood/12345

Jia: 4132 is green, changelog entry updated. @Maria can we merge docs first?

Sam: Approved 4132 :thumbsup:

Alex: Left a couple review comments on 4123 about the fallback table ordering — minor, please address and re-request review.

Leo: Pushed a small patch to 4123 addressing Alex's comments. @Alex please re-review when you have a moment.

Alex: Re-reviewed, LGTM. Approving now. Will merge after CI is green.

deploy-bot: PR #4123 CI failed on unit-tests (flaky: test_kernel_x). Retrying...

Alex: Test is flaky, kicked CI. If it fails twice, we should mark as flaky and track an issue rather than block the cut.

deploy-bot: PR #4123 CI passed.

Alex: Merged 4123 — will be included in the tag at cut.

Maria: Final checklist — all release PRs merged? Backports merged? Changelog updated? Tagging assigned to @Sam. If yes, I'll proceed with cut at 17:00 UTC.

Sam: Tagging ready. Backport PR 4140 merged and patched. All green from my side.

Jia: Changelog has entries for the three PRs, and docs updated.

Maria: Executing release cut in 10 mins. If anyone has urgent hold, reply here now.

Leo: All clear.

Sam: Good luck :rocket:

deploy-bot: Release job started: https://ci.internal/redwood/release/789

deploy-bot: Release v0.8.3 published. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v0.8.3

Maria: Release done. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with post-release checklist in #eng-releases later.
